thesis: The page is a ground survey sheet: Florida land comes in four readable classes, each with its own sample rate, machine and timeline, and the density legend ties every number on the page back to a type of ground.

signature.name: density legend
signature.summary: Four hatch patterns (dots, crosses, dashes, lines) for ground classes reused as tile overlays, section textures, price row markers, estimator fills and service badges.

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles draw hatch overlay then fade to photo, under 1s
stories: acreage bar fills by density class as estimator inputs change
motion.hover: hairline underline grows from left via scaleX 200ms
